It's okay to feel overwhelmed."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thank you. Sometimes it feels like I'm just not able to catch a break. I've been trying to keep track of everything with my journal, but it feels like every day brings something new."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Journaling is a great tool, and it's a good step that you're using it to process your thoughts and feelings. But with my job performance not being where it's supposed to be, and money problems, I just feel stuck."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Feeling stuck is definitely tough.
